description_en: Checks the connectivity of a storage data source used for schedule migration. You can submit a workflow migration task only after the connectivity check is passed
description_zh: 校验调度迁移所用存储数据源的连通性，连通性通过后方可提交工作流迁移任务
kebab_example: aliyun lhm exec-workflow-connectivity --ds-config '{"endpoint":"...","token":"000000"}' --ds-name test_ds318_hangzhou_0428 --ds-type Hive --ds-version 3.2.0 --id 10001 --is-modified true --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecWorkflowConnectivity

parameters.help_en: The datasource config. The value is a JSON character string whose structure is defined by each dsType. Parse the JSON string before use. Sensitive fields such as tokens are masked in the response
parameters.help_zh: 数据源配置，JSON 字符串形式，结构由各 dsType 自行定义，使用时需先做 JSON 解析；token 等敏感字段在响应中会脱敏
parameters.name: ds_config

parameters.help_en: The data source name. Exact match and fuzzy match are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据源名称，支持精确匹配或模糊匹配
parameters.name: ds_name

parameters.help_en: The data source type, such as Hive or MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh: 数据源类型，例如 Hive、MaxCompute 等
parameters.name: ds_type

parameters.help_en: The primary key ID that uniquely identifies a record
parameters.help_zh: 主键 ID，唯一标识一条记录
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the configuration has been modified
parameters.name: is_modified

data.description_en: The business data flag returned by the operation. The specific meaning varies by operation
data.description_zh: 接口返回的业务数据标志，具体含义随接口而异

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues with this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, check errCode and errMessage for details
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
